name: Four-Week Strength for Running Calibration
description:
Four-week strength-training bundle built around daily running, the patched running calibration block, and the running support layer. Upper body maintains/improves physique; lower body is runner-centric, low-volume force production and durability rather than bodybuilding leg volume.

Companion bundles: four-week-running-calibration-patched (training_priority): Running calibration remains the priority. Strength should not contaminate HR/RPE calibration data. four-week-running-support-calibration (coordinate_load): Do not stack duplicate calf, soleus, hamstring, adductor, and core work if support cards are also active.

Program intent: upper-body physique maintenance plus runner-centric lower-body strength.

Default weekly structure: Push A / Lower A / Pull A / Push B / Lower B / Long-run no lift / Pull B.

Week 3 exception: During optional LTHR-test week, remove Lower B and make post-test upper lifting optional/light..

Progression model: Double progression: add reps inside the target range before adding load. Deload in Week 4..

Readiness gate: Run mechanics feel normal; No tendon pain above mild background noise; No unusual HR/RPE drift from prior day; No shoulder/elbow pain before pressing or pulling; No calf/Achilles/hamstring/adductor soreness before lower sessions.

Reduce if: Easy runs start feeling weird or heavy for more than 2 days; Calves/Achilles or hamstrings feel reactive; LTHR test is completed in Week 3; Sleep/fueling is poor; Upper joints feel irritated from pressing/curls.

card_templates.name: Push A — Chest + Side Delts
card_templates.summary: Chest emphasis with side delts and triceps. Upper-body physique work without leg fatigue.

payload.instructions: 45-minute session. Main chest-focused push day. Stop compounds with 1-3 reps in reserve; isolations can approach failure only if joints feel good.

exercises.label: Bench press or machine press
exercises.detail: Controlled reps. Add weight only after hitting the top of the range cleanly.

exercises.label: Seated dumbbell shoulder press
exercises.detail: Stop if shoulder path feels cranky; landmine press is acceptable.

exercises.label: Lateral raise
exercises.detail: High visual payoff. Strict reps, no trap-dominant swinging.

exercises.label: Triceps pressdown
exercises.detail: Elbows quiet. Pump work, not a max lift.

card_templates.name: Push B — Upper Chest + Shoulders
card_templates.summary: Upper chest and delts with moderate triceps work.

payload.instructions: 40-minute session. Second push day biases upper chest and shoulders. Keep this crisp after any steady or diagnostic running.

exercises.label: Incline bench press
exercises.detail: Main lift. Keep shoulder blades set and reps smooth.

exercises.label: Overhead press or landmine press
exercises.detail: Use landmine if shoulders prefer it.

exercises.label: Overhead triceps extension
exercises.detail: Long-head triceps work. Stop if elbows complain.

exercises.label: Optional push-up finisher
exercises.detail: Only if fresh. Leave at least 2 reps in reserve.

card_templates.name: Pull A — Lats + Mid Traps
card_templates.summary: Back-width, rows, rear delts, traps, and biceps.

payload.instructions: 45-minute session. Back-width and scapular-control day. Let rows and pulldowns drive the session; curls are finishers.

exercises.label: Pull-ups or lat pulldown
exercises.detail: Full range, chest tall, no biceps-only pulling.

exercises.label: Chest-supported row
exercises.detail: Pause briefly with shoulder blades back.

exercises.label: Rear delt fly
exercises.detail: Rear delt and mid-trap feel; avoid shrugging.

exercises.label: Face pull
exercises.detail: Scapular control, external rotation, no heaving.

exercises.label: Dumbbell shrug
exercises.detail: Up and slightly back. Do not roll shoulders.

exercises.label: Curl variation
exercises.detail: Biceps finish. Stop if elbows get irritated.

card_templates.name: Pull B — Thickness + Rear Delts
card_templates.summary: Rows, rear delts, carries, hammer curls, and upper-back frame.

payload.instructions: 45-minute session. Back-thickness and rear-delt day. This is useful on recovery days because it avoids leg fatigue.

exercises.label: Machine row or barbell row
exercises.detail: Use machine/chest support if lower back is tired from running/lower lifting.

exercises.label: Seated cable row with pause
exercises.detail: Pause in retraction without leaning back excessively.

exercises.label: Trap-3 raise or chest-supported rear-delt row
Farmer carry
exercises.detail: Tall posture. Skip if grip or traps are overly fatigued.

exercises.label: Hammer curl
exercises.detail: Neutral grip for brachialis/forearm with elbow-friendly loading.

exercises.label: Incline curl or cable curl
exercises.detail: Optional second biceps angle. Do not chase arm soreness.

card_templates.name: Lower A — Runner Force Production
card_templates.summary: Low-volume machine squat and hinge work for force production without leg hypertrophy chasing.

payload.instructions: 30-minute session. This is not bodybuilding leg day. Use the squat machine as the main force tool. Stop all compounds with 2-3 reps in reserve.

exercises.label: Machine squat
exercises.detail: Heavy-ish, clean reps, full comfortable depth. No grinders.

exercises.label: Romanian deadlift
exercises.detail: Controlled hinge; stop before hamstring soreness hunting.

exercises.label: Standing calf raise
exercises.detail: Do only if not doing lower-leg support within 24h.

exercises.label: Tibialis raise
exercises.detail: Maintenance only; skip if support bundle already covers it.

exercises.label: Pallof press or side plank
exercises.detail: Only if not duplicating Core A/Core B support work.

exercises.label: Post-session ratings
exercises.detail: Leg freshness after (1-5); Risk to next run (1-5)

card_templates.name: Lower B — Runner Posterior Chain
card_templates.summary: Low-dose hip thrust, hamstring, and single-leg hinge work for running durability.

payload.instructions: 30-minute session. Posterior-chain durability without soreness. If the support bundle's hamstring/adductor block is active this week, either skip that support block or reduce this session.

exercises.label: Hip thrust
exercises.detail: Prefer hip thrust over heavy trap-bar deadlift during calibration; lower systemic fatigue.

exercises.label: Hamstring curl
exercises.detail: Slow eccentric. Stop well before cramping or technical failure.

exercises.label: Single-leg RDL
exercises.detail: Light/moderate. Square hips, balance, clean hinge.

exercises.label: Bent-knee soleus raise
exercises.detail: Only if not doing lower-leg support nearby.

exercises.label: Copenhagen regression or adductor squeeze
exercises.detail: Only if not doing support-hamstring/adductor work this week.

card_templates.name: Strength Skip — LTHR Test Day
card_templates.summary: Explicit no-lift card for the diagnostic running test day.

payload.instructions: 3-minute review. No strength training today if the LTHR test is completed. The diagnostic run is enough.

items.label: Did you complete the LTHR test?
Strength decision: skipped / did light upper / should have skipped

card_templates.name: Strength Weekly Review
card_templates.summary: Review whether strength supported or interfered with running.

payload.instructions: 5-minute review. Do not grade strength in isolation. The question is whether lifting preserved upper physique and helped running without contaminating calibration.

items.label: Upper body: enough stimulus, too much, or too little?
Lower body: stronger/durable, unchanged, or sore/heavy?
Did lifting change easy-run feel, HR, or mechanics?
Any shoulder, elbow, Achilles, hamstring, adductor, or knee issues?
Next week adjustment: keep / reduce / move / skip anything?

routine_specs.name: Four-Week Strength for Running Calibration
routine_specs.notes: Designed to coexist with daily running. Week 3 deliberately reduces lower-body strength around the optional LTHR diagnostic test. Week 4 deloads. Coordinate with the support bundle to avoid duplicate lower-leg and hamstring/adductor work. The priority session goes first. For this block, run first; lift later whenever possible. Aim for 6+ hours between run and lift; 3-4 hours minimum for upper-only sessions. Leg work should make you stronger and more durable, not sore. No leg compounds to failure. Upper body can train closer to hypertrophy volume, but avoid elbow/shoulder irritation. Push days finish with triceps; pull days finish with biceps. Avoid turning every day into an arm day.

prescription_override_json.title: Push A — calibration dose
prescription_override_json.instructions: Run first. Afternoon upper-body baseline. Keep compounds at RIR 2-3 and avoid extra sets.

prescription_override_json.title: Lower A — first runner-force exposure
prescription_override_json.instructions: Do this after the stride run, ideally 6+ hours later. This is deliberately short.

exercises.label: Machine squat
exercises.detail: Use the machine you like. Heavy-ish but not hard.

exercises.label: Romanian deadlift
exercises.detail: Controlled, shallow enough to avoid soreness.

exercises.label: Standing calf raise
exercises.detail: Skip if lower-leg support is within 24h.

prescription_override_json.companion_support_adjustment: Micro-primer is fine; do not add extra lower-leg support today.

prescription_override_json.title: Pull A — baseline dose
prescription_override_json.instructions: Upper pull after recovery run. Keep rows strict and biceps modest.

prescription_override_json.title: Push B — upper-chest baseline
prescription_override_json.instructions: Do after the easy-only calibration run. Keep it clean so the HR/RPE baseline remains readable.
prescription_override_json.companion_support_adjustment: If lower-leg support is also scheduled today, do support after lifting or separate by hours.

prescription_override_json.title: Lower B — first posterior-chain exposure
prescription_override_json.instructions: Very light. Do not create hamstring/adductor soreness before the long run weekend.
prescription_override_json.long_run_guard: Stop if anything feels like it will affect tomorrow's long run.

prescription_override_json.title: Pull B — recovery-day upper pull
prescription_override_json.instructions: No lifting on long-run day. Pull B moves to recovery day and stays moderate.

exercises.label: Farmer carry
exercises.detail: Skip if tired from long run.

prescription_override_json.title: Week 1 strength review
prescription_override_json.instructions: Decide whether lower sessions changed running feel. If yes, reduce lower volume first.

prescription_override_json.title: Push A — full working dose
prescription_override_json.instructions: Normal upper-body dose. Progress reps, not ego load.

exercises.label: Cable or machine fly
exercises.detail: Add if time and shoulders good.

prescription_override_json.title: Lower A — normal runner-force dose
prescription_override_json.instructions: After strides, separated by hours. This is the main lower strength session of the week.

exercises.label: Machine squat
exercises.detail: Clean force work. No bodybuilding pump chase.

exercises.label: Romanian deadlift
exercises.detail: Enough hinge stimulus, no hamstring damage hunt.

exercises.label: Standing calf raise
exercises.detail: Skip if lower-leg support is active nearby.

prescription_override_json.companion_support_adjustment: If lower-leg support is also active today, skip optional calves/tibialis here.

prescription_override_json.title: Pull A — full working dose
prescription_override_json.instructions: Back and traps get real work. Curls still stay modest.

prescription_override_json.title: Push B — after steady-aerobic check
prescription_override_json.instructions: Only do full version if the steady run felt controlled. Otherwise cut pressing by one set each.

conditional_adjustment.if_run_felt_hard: Cut pb2 and pb3 by one set each; keep lateral raises/triceps light.

prescription_override_json.title: Lower B — posterior-chain dose
prescription_override_json.instructions: Do this instead of the support bundle's hamstring/adductor block, or cut both in half. Do not stack full versions.

exercises.label: Hip thrust
exercises.detail: Main posterior-chain strength with low systemic cost.

exercises.label: Soleus or adductor optional
exercises.detail: Only if not duplicating support bundle.

prescription_override_json.companion_support_adjustment: Skip support-hamstring-adductor today unless this session is reduced to 50%.

prescription_override_json.title: Pull B — recovery-day upper pull
prescription_override_json.instructions: Moderate after long-run weekend. Keep farmer carries optional.

prescription_override_json.title: Week 2 strength review
prescription_override_json.instructions: Main decision: does full 6-day lifting coexist with running, or should Week 3 stay reduced even if the LTHR test is skipped?

prescription_override_json.title: Push A — normal upper, no overreach
prescription_override_json.instructions: Start LTHR week with normal upper-body work but no extra volume.

exercises.label: Bench press or machine press
exercises.detail: Do not chase PRs this week.

prescription_override_json.title: Lower A — reduced pre-LTHR force work
prescription_override_json.instructions: Reduced lower dose before the optional LTHR test. Do not add optional calf/tib work.

exercises.label: Machine squat
exercises.detail: Use the machine you like. Heavy-ish but not hard.

exercises.label: Romanian deadlift
exercises.detail: Controlled, shallow enough to avoid soreness.

exercises.label: Standing calf raise
exercises.detail: Skip if lower-leg support is within 24h.

prescription_override_json.lthr_guard: Keep this at RIR 3-4. If legs are not fresh, skip RDL.

prescription_override_json.title: Pull A — moderate before LTHR test
prescription_override_json.instructions: Upper pull is fine, but keep farmer/shrug/grip fatigue under control.

prescription_override_json.title: No strength if LTHR test completed
prescription_override_json.instructions: This is an intentional no-lift card. The diagnostic run is the day's hard work.

conditional_adjustment.if_lthr_test_skipped: You may move Push B here only if run was easy and legs feel normal; otherwise keep no-lift.

prescription_override_json.title: Push B — post-test light option
prescription_override_json.instructions: If you completed the LTHR test yesterday, do this at 50-70% volume or skip. If test was skipped, normal moderate Push B is allowed.

prescription_override_json.title: Pull B — light recovery-day upper
prescription_override_json.instructions: Keep this light if the LTHR test was completed. No Lower B this week unless the test was skipped and you feel excellent.

prescription_override_json.title: Week 3 strength review
prescription_override_json.instructions: Judge whether reduced lower lifting protected the LTHR test and recovery. Do not force six sessions this week.

prescription_override_json.title: Push A — deload
prescription_override_json.instructions: Half-volume upper push. Keep movement quality, drop fatigue.

prescription_override_json.title: Lower A — deload force work
prescription_override_json.instructions: Minimal lower dose. Preserve the pattern; no fatigue.
prescription_override_json.companion_support_adjustment: Skip optional calves/tibialis if lower-leg support is active today.

prescription_override_json.title: Pull A — deload
prescription_override_json.instructions: Half-volume upper pull.

prescription_override_json.title: Push B — optional deload after steady check
prescription_override_json.instructions: If the steady check felt harder than expected, skip this. Otherwise do a short upper pump.

prescription_override_json.title: Lower B — half-dose posterior chain
prescription_override_json.instructions: Only do this if Week 2 Lower B caused no soreness. Otherwise replace with mobility/support only.
prescription_override_json.companion_support_adjustment: Do not also do full support-hamstring-adductor today. Pick one half-dose only.

prescription_override_json.title: Pull B — final deload
prescription_override_json.instructions: Short upper pull to close the block.

prescription_override_json.title: Week 4 final strength review
prescription_override_json.instructions: Decide what should survive into the next block: six lifting days, five lifting days, or four upper + one lower.
final_decision_prompts: Did upper-body volume preserve or improve physique?
Did lower-body strength improve run feel or create noise?
Was Pull B on recovery day sustainable?
Should the next block include real threshold with lower lifting reduced?
Which optional lower-leg/hamstring pieces should be owned by support bundle instead of strength bundle?
